product.name: Twilio Conversations
product.description: A platform for building continuous, multi-channel conversations between customers, human agents, and AI agents, with persistent context and orchestration.

product.name: Twilio Messaging APIs
product.description: APIs for sending, receiving, and managing SMS, MMS, RCS, WhatsApp, and other business messages at scale.

product.name: Twilio Voice API
product.description: A programmable voice service for adding inbound and outbound calling, call control, and intelligent voice experiences to applications.

product.name: Twilio Segment
product.description: A customer data platform that collects, unifies, governs, and activates first-party customer data for personalized engagement and real-time insights.

product.description: An API-based email delivery service for creating, sending, and managing transactional and marketing email at scale.

product.description: A programmable cloud contact center for orchestrating inbound and outbound customer interactions across communication channels.
